notes: v6.2.2 - HOTFIX for the Chrome sign-in read. On current Chrome versions the cookies are protected with DPAPI / App-Bound encryption, so an outside program cannot decrypt them at all: with v6.2.1's Chrome method, yt-dlp failed with 'Failed to decrypt with DPAPI' even with Chrome fully closed, and the 'close Chrome' advice could not fix an encryption wall. Settings > YouTube sign-in now offers three ways to read the sign-in: Chrome (as before), Firefox (sign in to YouTube in Firefox once), or a cookies.txt file you export once from your browser (the free 'Get cookies.txt LOCALLY' extension in Chrome: open youtube.com signed in, Export, save as cookies.txt in your NaloxAura folder). The panel names the encryption wall for what it is and points at the method switch. Everything else is exactly v6.2.1. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
